historicalPrecedent.where: art/backgrounds/room-03-nugget.png -- the ORIGINAL shipping Nugget background, still in the tree, and the thing art/staging/room-03/clean-plate-* was made by cleaning
historicalPrecedent.what: four men seated AT the card table and three at the bar, drawn in the same pass as the furniture: hips on the chair seats, forearms over the tabletop rim, boots on the floor between the pedestal feet, the tabletop crossing their laps; at the bar, one man leaning with a boot on the foot rail and one seated on a stool with the counter corner crossing his forearm
historicalPrecedent.why it was superseded: the figures are cropped and headless and the plate had people baked into it, which the no-person-in-a-plate rule forbids
historicalPrecedent.what it proves: the SPATIAL METHOD, not the art: those bodies were authored against that furniture, which is why they make contact. Nothing since has been.

whyIndependentSpriteStagingFailed: the seven furniture-dependent patrons were generated as free-standing figures with NO furniture in the request -- the prompts said "posed as though the bar and the stool were there, and the room will supply them" -- so each drawing invented its own seat height and its own counter height
the room supplies exactly one number per character, a floor row, from which the depth curve derives a height; two independent contacts (hips AND forearms) cannot both be satisfied by one scalar

content/rooms/nugget-candidate.json declares occlusionPlanes: [] and every walk box carries clipPlane: 0, so NOTHING in this room can draw in front of an actor. The tabletop physically cannot cross a lap and the bar front cannot hide a leg, whatever the coordinates say.
engineFinding: the engine already has the mechanism this needs. RoomFile.occlusionPlanes is a list of {level, mask} where the mask is a 1-bit stencil over the BACKGROUND'S OWN PIXELS and is never drawn -- so plate-derived occlusion costs no art, duplicates no furniture and cannot shift a pixel. AmbientFile.clipPlane lets a single patron opt into a plane without touching a walk box, so Thad is unaffected. Renderer.masked() is the code. It is unused in this room.

minimumGenerationProposal.howTheFurnitureIsUsedAndNotShipped: the furniture is in the REQUEST as the geometry to compose against and never in the OUTPUT that ships. Because the input crop is known exactly, the people are extracted by differencing the result against that unmodified crop: every pixel that changed is a person. The extracted people ship as individual actors with anchors read from the composition, and the table and bar are occluded at runtime by masks cut from the accepted plate. The plate itself is never rewritten, no furniture is redrawn, and no person is ever baked into a plate.

statusIfUnauthorized: nothing changes. The room stays exactly as deployed, which is wrong, and this report is the reason rather than another round of coordinates.
